svg.title: How a Prisma Compute app reaches Prisma Postgres
svg.desc: One region holds a Prisma Compute app and a Prisma Postgres database; the app connects to the database over TLS through its public endpoint, and a planned internal network per project is shown as a dashed link. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand.

g.text: Over TLS today, an internal network per project is planned
Planned: an internal network, so Postgres can be private
